title: OLEANDER Architecture Design Development Process v1.0
purpose: Machine-readable carrier of the Current Architecture ADD-00…17 professional reference process, preserving its native planning/development semantics while exposing the same R-E interface, readback, assurance and claim-ceiling contract used by other professional domains.
authority_position: Current Architecture reference process subordinate to OLEANDER Master Runtime, Current Knowledge Authority, Professional Domain Process Contract, Cross-Disciplinary Integration, project/jurisdiction authority and responsible architect. This JSON is a machine-readable carrier of the existing Current prose process, not a second Architecture process.

trigger.project_flow_trigger: A project makes a material architectural planning/design-development claim requiring room, flow, zoning, plan/section, code-aware, system-fit or architectural independent-review evidence.
responsibility_triggers: Architecture owns or coordinates a consequential spatial/shared variable
another domain consumes architectural geometry/use/level/opening/room variables
architectural Design KEEP is being considered
trigger.claim_ceiling_rule: The lowest valid ceiling across project/program/site authority, current architecture stage evidence, specialist interfaces, actual readback and independent review governs.
not_triggered_when: artifact is presentation-only with no architectural claim
task is wholly owned by another profession without architectural shared variable

knowledge_binding.consequential_knowledge_rule: Consequential architectural brief, regulatory, precedent, technical, site/user/operation and existing-condition knowledge must be admitted through the task/claim Operational Mount before supporting closure.
precedent_case_routes: bounded architectural precedents with applicable program/site/technical relation
practice_routes: Current OLEANDER architecture projects and failure/readback evidence
tool_knowledge_routes: current CAD/BIM/GIS/model/render/data tools when used; tool does not own professional judgment

practitioner_object_contracts.professional_purpose: Carry room-level use, occupancy, equipment and operational judgments into plan development without reducing them to area numbers.
practitioner_object_contracts.native_source_of_truth: Current room brief + user/operation evidence + controlled architectural room/space data.
practitioner_object_contracts.revision_identity: room_or_space_id + controlled brief revision + architectural baseline revision
practitioner_object_contracts.release_or_retention_rule: Retain only when material use/capacity/equipment/interface conflicts are dispositioned or explicitly OPEN with owner and downstream limit.
failure_or_hold_conditions: room exists only as area target
critical user or statutory dependency missing
practitioner_object_contracts.independent_review_requirement: Independent architectural review must challenge representative high-risk rooms and the strongest user/equipment conflict, not just completeness.

practitioner_object_contracts.object_name: Site / Existing Condition / Brief Assumption Register
practitioner_object_contracts.professional_purpose: Keep site, existing-building, brief and phasing assumptions visible with authority, confidence and consequences.
practitioner_object_contracts.native_source_of_truth: Current site/survey/existing-condition sources + project brief authority + field/evidence boundary.
practitioner_object_contracts.revision_identity: assumption_id + source revision + architectural baseline revision
practitioner_object_contracts.release_or_retention_rule: No assumption may be retained as fact; downstream release must expose unresolved consequential assumptions and claim ceiling.
failure_or_hold_conditions: bare assumption used as authoritative geometry
practitioner_object_contracts.independent_review_requirement: Independent review must sample the assumptions with highest consequence and weakest authority.

practitioner_object_contracts.object_name: Zoning / Massing / Circulation Option Comparison Set
practitioner_object_contracts.professional_purpose: Compare materially different architectural organizations before plan lock, including spatial, circulation, system, cost and lifecycle consequences.
practitioner_object_contracts.native_source_of_truth: Editable option plans/diagrams/models + common brief/criteria baseline.
practitioner_object_contracts.revision_identity: option_id + option source revision + shared comparison baseline
practitioner_object_contracts.release_or_retention_rule: Do not retain an option solely from render quality or weighted score; hard conflicts and unresolved controlling interfaces remain explicit.
practitioner_object_contracts.independent_review_requirement: Independent review must compare causal strategy differences and attack the selected option with the strongest rejected alternative.

practitioner_object_contracts.object_name: Controlled Plan / Section / Level Baseline Set
practitioner_object_contracts.professional_purpose: Carry the actual spatial design as editable coordinated plans, sections, levels and room/equipment information rather than presentation-only drawings.
practitioner_object_contracts.native_source_of_truth: Owner-native architectural CAD/BIM/vector/model sources designated as Current for the decision scope.
practitioner_object_contracts.revision_identity: baseline_id + exact native artifact revision/hash + issue/release revision
practitioner_object_contracts.release_or_retention_rule: Presentation exports cannot replace the native baseline; downstream reliance requires exact revision and readback of material plan/section consistency.
required_readback: critical vertical circulation and threshold readback
practitioner_object_contracts.independent_review_requirement: Independent review must inspect the exact native/current baseline or authoritative derivative tied to it.

practitioner_object_contracts.professional_purpose: Control architectural release of openings, doors, envelope interfaces, room/equipment data and later submittal/mockup decisions before downstream reliance.
practitioner_object_contracts.native_source_of_truth: Current architectural baseline + controlled interface/submittal evidence.
practitioner_object_contracts.revision_identity: release_item_id + native source revision + submittal/mockup revision
practitioner_object_contracts.release_or_retention_rule: Release requires exact source/revision, disposition and conditions; conditional release does not close unresolved professional/statutory dependencies.
practitioner_object_contracts.independent_review_requirement: Distinct checker/reviewer required for material release items with safety, interface or procurement consequence.

practitioner_object_contracts.object_name: Architecture RFI / Field Change / Nonconformity Record
practitioner_object_contracts.professional_purpose: Bind construction/site questions and deviations to exact design sources, impact, disposition and required re-readback.
practitioner_object_contracts.native_source_of_truth: Site/RFI/nonconformity evidence + current issued architectural information.
practitioner_object_contracts.revision_identity: field_item_id + affected issue revision + field evidence date
practitioner_object_contracts.release_or_retention_rule: Field disposition cannot silently amend native Current; material changes require controlled source revision and affected reviews reopened.
practitioner_object_contracts.independent_review_requirement: Independent/second review when field change affects life safety, accessibility, primary circulation, significant envelope/opening or other material risk.

practitioner_object_contracts.professional_purpose: Close architectural open items and retain record/use information needed for operations, future change and bounded in-use learning.
practitioner_object_contracts.native_source_of_truth: Approved record information + defects/open-item evidence + operations/use readback within architectural scope.
practitioner_object_contracts.release_or_retention_rule: Installed/record state must remain distinct from design intent; unresolved items and future-change constraints remain explicit.
required_readback: record plan/section vs accepted field information
representative in-use spatial/use readback when claimed
practitioner_object_contracts.independent_review_requirement: Independent closeout review where contractual/risk consequence requires; in-use observations must remain context bounded.
does_not_prove: field truth outside accepted record scope

practitioner_object_contracts.object_name: Independent Architecture Plan / Section Review Record
practitioner_object_contracts.professional_purpose: Attack the strongest plausible plan/section failure on the exact Current baseline before professional retention.
practitioner_object_contracts.native_source_of_truth: Exact controlled architectural baseline + declared review scope + active interface/authority evidence.
practitioner_object_contracts.release_or_retention_rule: Review verdict applies only to reviewed scope/baseline; material change automatically stales the affected review.
practitioner_object_contracts.independent_review_requirement: Reviewer must be distinct enough to challenge production assumptions and bind every conclusion to the exact baseline.

practitioner_object_contracts.professional_purpose: Propagate material architectural changes to affected spaces, drawings, interfaces, reviews and downstream releases without blanket invalidation or silent staleness.
practitioner_object_contracts.native_source_of_truth: Controlled change request/event + dependency links from current architectural objects.
practitioner_object_contracts.release_or_retention_rule: Change closes only after affected Current artifacts/reviews/interfaces are re-established or explicitly retained with evidence.
practitioner_object_contracts.independent_review_requirement: Independent review required when change materially affects previously reviewed high-risk architectural relations.

assurance.professional_review: Architecture professional review at the current stage/claim ceiling, separate from presentation quality and specialist approvals.
assurance.evidence_review: Verify program/site/existing/code/user/technical evidence against the architectural claim and exact Current geometry.
assurance.independent_review: ADD-17 requires a distinct architectural reread of the exact Current plan/sections without relying on producer intent, renders or prior KEEP/PASS labels.
does_not_prove: Design KEEP beyond architecture review scope

stale_scope_rules: only affected ADD decisions/interfaces/artifacts/reviews become stale unless dependency analysis shows wider consequence
upstream_impact_rules: changed brief/site/survey/code/specialist authority reopens consuming architectural decisions
downstream_impact_rules: changed architectural controlled variables propagate to consuming Structure/MEP/Interior/Landscape/Lighting/Fire/Accessibility/Civil/Operations interfaces
interface_reopen_rules: material shared-variable changes reopen affected Cross-Disciplinary Integration interfaces
receipt_stale_rules: Architecture receipt becomes stale at affected scope when governing geometry/evidence/review baseline changes

process_exit_conditions: applicable ADD stage work complete at declared claim ceiling
critical specialist interfaces meet required maturity
ADD-17 independent plan/section review complete when Design KEEP is considered
open_items_allowed: explicit later/outside-claim specialist, statutory, construction or handover items that do not contradict the current architectural verdict
completion_contract.promotion_effect: A bounded Architecture PASS may satisfy only the Architecture professional-process prerequisite at its declared claim ceiling; it does not grant specialist/statutory PASS or Project Promotion.
